text_block_list.text:
Before heading to Kyoto Racecourse
to run in the Mile CS—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —And then she says, 'Even samba sounds like bang bang chicken, doesn't it!?' That totally got everyone cracking up!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... so,
what happened to the bang bang chicken in the end... umm.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!
We still have time, don't we!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, Helios.
That's enough, so head over to the racetrack, okay?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You're just being considerate of me, right?
Because I showed you that side of myself."

K.S. Miracle suffered a severe injury on the day of the Sprinters Stakes.
Regrettably, the diagnosis was that she would never
be able to run at full speed again.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Even today is just a routine checkup admission anyway,
and we can talk anytime in class or at the dorms."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even so, both you and Ruby are so kind...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes,
they came before the two of you arrived.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Making everyone worry like that... I'm so pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I'm worried!
I am, but! That's just how I roll!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I totally hate it when Miracle's down!
So like, once she's hyped up again, we're definitely gonna—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. 
Beyond that... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh,
umm...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Helios. Do your best... in the race.
I'm really cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run gives me strength.
And I mean that... truly, from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!? Then you better watch me!
On your phone, tablet, TV, whatever!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm always causing a ruckus
at MAX volume☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Miracle was super bummed out after all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I guess that makes sense.
Not being able to run... I wonder what that feels like.

She acted like her usual self in the hospital room...
but it seems she still hasn't shaken off
the shock of the accident.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"At the training camp...
I ended up provoking Miracle."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome, go ahead and surpass them!
Surpassing gods and demons would be a total miracle☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know.
I had no idea things would turn out like that...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I know.
Miracle just did what she wanted to do.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"An' so, it just kinda turned out that way.
I get it, but—"

"And Daitaku Helios isn't the only one
who's shaken—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright, looking forward to working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...For Miracle's sake too, every single one of us has gotta finish safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone seems kinda different from usual. Can't be helped, though...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, seeing you like this makes me feel down too.
Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Daiichi Ruby's here.
She skipped the winner's interview for the Sprinters Stakes, though...

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't she seem totally fine?
As expected of a highborn noble lady, she's mentally tough.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Just now, y'see!
Miracle's—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I must concentrate now,
so if you will excuse me."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnnnnghhhh-aaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uuuuurrrgh...
"After the recent accident, a very heavy atmosphere hangs over the entire racing world."

I thought even Daitaku Helios might have caught the bug.
Or so I believed, until—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Nothing left to do but go for it!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's vibe is down!
Times like this are totally what party animals are for!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"My vibes are seriously insane!
When I get hyped, everyone's gotta get hyped too!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle and the young lady too! Yeah, absolutely☆

Daitaku Helios pays careful attention to her surroundings.
And even while doing so, she was the only one looking firmly ahead.
choice_data_list: If anyone can turn a downer into a hype moment, it's Helios!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm always raising hell
at MAX volume!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaayyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna hype myself up on my own terms!
And I won't let anyone bring me down!! Pure hype!!"
